source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 8ης Μαΐου — «Όσιος Μήλης ο Υμνωδός»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 8 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. **The whole account is one sentence** — «Ο Όσιος Μήλης (ή Μήλος ή Μαλλός) απεβίωσε ειρηνικά.» — over a distich that calls him a hymn-maker. **The three name forms are the page's own parenthesis** and all three are recorded as Greek forms for that reason; none is transliterated and none is preferred. No century, no country, no monastery, no see, no relics and no hymn of his own. `hymnographer` is taken from the listing's «ο Υμνωδός» and nothing else: the page names no hymn of his that survives. **The name sweep's `malachi` and `malachias-of-rhodes` are other men**, raised on the fold of the name alone, and neither is kept on this day.
